# Intergalactic Spaceship Version 2

Model and textures by Dennis Haupt (3DHaupt).

Source: https://free3d.com/3d-model/intergalactic-spaceships-version-2-blender-292-eevee-359585.html

Creator's terms: "You can use my 3d-model only for non-commercial, personal/private and editorial use!"

Used for the Nantes class prototype. The hull was converted from GLB to OBJ and centered. Original textures are kept; lighting, flight, and exhaust were changed.

Keep these terms with the model. This does not grant commercial use or permission to redistribute the model on its own.
